title: Radial fall of two A particles from r0 = 9: the full A-A force profile in one run
pitch: H30 (2026-11-23) found the constant-K law K/r^2.5 with K = 17.7 holds at separations 3 and 5 but not at 7 (K_fit 15.1) or 9 (K_fit 11.6), each replicated to about 2 percent. One trajectory that falls from r0 = 9 at rest sweeps every separation from 9 down to contact. A fit of the separation-dependent coefficient K(r) over that whole run (no assumed exponent) would show the shape of the force, including whether it is screened as in P-0003's alternative form. Two particles, dense sampling, T = 10.
